activity.notes: Charles the Bold succeeded Philip the Good on 15 June 1467 and ruled the composite Burgundian State until his death at Nancy on 5 January 1477. ATLAS uses Burgundian State rather than only Duchy of Burgundy because his political rule encompassed the wider Valois-Burgundian territorial complex, while preserving Duke of Burgundy as his principal title.

sources.title: Charles the Bold in Italy, 1467–1477 — Cambridge University Press
sources.citation_text: Cambridge states that Charles became Duke of Burgundy on 15 June 1467 and inherited the major Burgundian territorial conglomerate.

sources.title: Charles, Duke of Burgundy — Encyclopaedia Britannica (1911)
